query: SELECT count(*) AS "n!" FROM businesses.business b WHERE b.status = 'active' AND b.after_hours AND b.after_hours_suspended_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.town t WHERE t.business_id = b.id AND t.town = $2) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.job_type_choice c WHERE c.business_id = b.id AND c.category = $1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.emergency_switch s JOIN businesses.team_member m ON m.id = s.member_id AND m.business_id = s.business_id WHERE s.business_id = b.id AND s.switch_on AND m.removed_at IS NULL AND m.confirm_and_billing AND s.yes_at > $3)
